page.overview:
Who is Bantha?

A Bantha is a Star Wars creature first introduced in 2006 before physically debuting as a brick-built figure in 2020.

A Bantha is a fictional creature resembling a ram or musk ox. As a brick-built figure, it is mostly comprised of reddish brown and dark brown bricks.

Banthas are sturdy and easily domesticated mammals used as beasts of burden by Tusken Raiders on Tatooine. It appears in LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy and LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga as an animal that can be ridden.
